liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Tennessee Jed** (2 reviews): The song features a huge crescendo during the first set; The band jams the song hard, indicating something significant is happening [11][16]
- **The Other One** (2 reviews): The song segues into a Jerry solo that develops into the Close Encounters theme; The second half of the song into the jam is absolutely amazing [9][20]
- **Saint Stephen** (2 reviews): The recording is cut before the jam climax, but the existing portion is highly energetic; The song started so perfectly that the listener was afraid to breathe [9][17]
- **Close Encounters Jam** (2 reviews): Jerry produces sounds resembling giant flutes during the jam; Jerry's low notes at the end leave the listener speechless [16][20]
- **The Music Never Stopped** (1 review): Jerry's wiggling leads are described as divine rapture, opening gates wide [15]

## The recordings

- **gd1978-01-22.sbd.miller.110632.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 20 songs; 180 min; rated 4.53/5 by 17 [1]
- **gd78-01-22.sbd.popi.4974.sbeok.shnf**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 21 songs; 162 min; rated 4.42/5 by 69 [3]. Said about its sound: The audio quality is described as great and well balanced; Added crowd noise creates perfect energy and atmosphere on the recording; The sound is hissy and less clean than a cassette copy [10][11][14]
- **gd1978-01-22.mtx.chappell.sb4.28846.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 21 songs; 164 min; rated 3.88/5 by 8 [4]. Said about its sound: The matrix combines FOB AUD and SBD, making the Pit energy palpable [4]
- **gd1978-01-22.sbd.unknown.31940.shnf**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 21 songs; 175 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [2]

## Around the show

- The crowd loved the performance, which the reviewer also enjoyed [11]
- It was a dark and stormy night in the graveyard across from the venue [19]
- Wind blew a flame, fusing the listener's eyelashes while they tripped on acid and hash [19]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1978-01-22.sbd.miller.110632.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Multiple Masters (Reels and Cassettes) -> My Hard Drive [1]. Also: Part of the show may have an extra cassette generation [1]
- **gd78-01-22.sbd.popi.4974.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard and Audience Composite [3]
- **gd1978-01-22.mtx.chappell.sb4.28846.flac16**: transferred by Chris Chappell; source: Matrix - see info file [4]. Also: Sources were SNH files from LMA, converted to WAV, then FLAC 16 [4]
- **gd1978-01-22.sbd.unknown.31940.shnf**: transferred by Unknown; source: ? SBD, 1st 4 songs in 2nd set AUD [2]
